name: James Beaumont
role: Sheep rancher down the river, known as 'Scotty'
bio: James A. Beaumont, known as 'Scotty,' ran a sheep ranch down the river and lost many sheep in the winter of early 1884, though by March he reported the deaths had nearly stopped. In May 1884 sheep pelts came in from his ranch, and his shack burned with everything he owned.

moments.label: Lost his shack and belongings to fire
